tagline: From Fort Stanwix up the Fulton Chain to Glens Falls.
intro: Out of Rome the trail runs north by Remsen and Woodgate into the Adirondack Park and up the Fulton Chain of Lakes, eight lakes that are really the Moose River dammed at Old Forge, through Inlet to Raquette Lake. It swings on by Blue Mountain Lake and Indian Lake, then follows the Hudson down to the shore of Lake George, where the view takes in the mountain-rimmed south end, and ends above the river at Glens Falls.

Around 1800 John Brown cut a 25-mile wagon trail up from Remsen to settle families at Old Forge, and the land would not farm. Old Forge has since kept a different distinction, New York's record low of 52 below.

moments.title: Fort Stanwix
moments.text: In Rome the Park Service has rebuilt the fort that guarded the Oneida Carry and held out against a British siege in August 1777.

moments.title: Inlet
moments.text: At the head of Fourth Lake, Chester Gillette was arrested at the Arrowhead Hotel in 1906, three days after the murder Dreiser made into An American Tragedy.

moments.title: Warrensburg
moments.text: Once called The Bridge for its Schroon River crossing, the town has a local claim that Cooper wrote The Last of the Mohicans upstairs on Main Street, though a short visit is likelier.
